description: Contributions de la concertation relative au projet de l'axe Nantes-Pornic conduit par le Département de Loire-Atlantique is a dataset listed in Loire-Atlantique - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de Loire-Atlantique. Contributions recueillies en ligne, dans les registres papier et par mail au cours de la concertation publique intitulée: Nantes-Pornic: quelle route pour demain ? Relative au projet d’aménagement à 2X2 voies de la RD 751, cette concertation préalable a été organisée par le Département de Loire-Atlantique, entre le 21 septembre et le 4 novembre 2020. Coverage: Loire-Atlantique. The portal files it under Citoyenneté / Institution. Its keywords are participation citoyenne, consultation, concertation, route. The portal shows 504 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2021-06-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-loire-atlantique-fr-portal.
